#version 330 core
// Generated by vmath ShaderHeader from the Java struct layouts. Do not edit.
#ifndef VMATH_AREAS
#define VMATH_AREAS

// std430, 48 bytes, alignment 16: fill@0, pattern@16, spacing@32, width@36, angle@40, kind@44
struct AreaStyle {
    vec4 fill;
    vec4 pattern;
    float spacing;
    float width;
    float angle;
    uint kind;
};

uniform usamplerBuffer styles_texels;

AreaStyle fetch_styles(int i) {
    uvec4 t0 = texelFetch(styles_texels, i * 3);
    uvec4 t1 = texelFetch(styles_texels, i * 3 + 1);
    uvec4 t2 = texelFetch(styles_texels, i * 3 + 2);
    AreaStyle r;
    r.fill = vec4(uintBitsToFloat(t0.x), uintBitsToFloat(t0.y), uintBitsToFloat(t0.z), uintBitsToFloat(t0.w));
    r.pattern = vec4(uintBitsToFloat(t1.x), uintBitsToFloat(t1.y), uintBitsToFloat(t1.z), uintBitsToFloat(t1.w));
    r.spacing = uintBitsToFloat(t2.x);
    r.width = uintBitsToFloat(t2.y);
    r.angle = uintBitsToFloat(t2.z);
    r.kind = t2.w;
    return r;
}

#endif // VMATH_AREAS
layout(location = 0) in vec2 a_position;
layout(location = 1) in uint a_word;
uniform mat4 u_viewProjection;
flat out vec4 v_fill;
flat out vec4 v_pattern;
flat out vec4 v_params;
flat out uint v_kind;

void main() {
    AreaStyle s = fetch_styles(int(a_word));
    gl_Position = u_viewProjection * vec4(a_position, 0.0, 1.0);
    v_fill = s.fill;
    v_pattern = s.pattern;
    v_params = vec4(s.spacing, s.width, s.angle, 0.0);
    v_kind = s.kind;
}
